'''Yalpor Waar''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] shopkeeper who operated [[To the Teeth]] weapon shop in the [[Shadowport/Legends|shadowport]] of [[Point Nadir]]. He was one of the most successful [[Merchant/Legends|merchants]] there, and was extremely knowledgeable about all kinds of weapons.<ref name="Scum and Villainy" />

Waar wore the loose-fitting robes of a Quarren [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]], and had several weapons stashed on his person. He had a gruff voice and was missing one of his facial tentacles.<ref name="Scum and Villainy" />
